name: Reorder reminder
purpose: Prompts a replacement before the old one wears out.

steps.name: About ten months in
steps.job: Explains the signs of wear and links the replacement.
steps.subject: Yours is about ten months old

rules: Only orders from the category that wears out.
Skipped if they ordered anything in the last 60 days.
why: The wait matches how long the product really lasts.
It opens with advice, so it reads as service.
watch: 300 days is one number for a whole category. Split by product when lifespans differ.
